items.title: Google releases EmbeddingGemma 2, an open multimodal embedding model
items.summary_en: According to the search-result description of the official Google blog post, EmbeddingGemma 2 is an open embedding model that places code, images, video and audio in one shared embedding space. It is reported to be built on the Gemma 4 architecture, to have about 740 million parameters, and to be released under an Apache 2.0 license.
